responses.text: I hope it will snow later.
Stupid Big Horners were making noise all night again.
Spotted some humans down the road. Could be Great Khans again.
Some days I miss being in the Master's army.
You think Marcus could get us some miniguns? Or missile launchers?
Better watch out. Lily's been babbling about her grandkids again.
Doctor Henry's pretty smart - for a human.
Ugh. Need to tighten up my vises again.
Damn mercs. Glad you got rid of them.
{Marcus dead}No more reason to stick around since Marcus is dead.
Thanks for helping Doctor Henry with his research.
{Imminent Cure}A cure for the Nightkin is supposed to be on the way.
{Eventual Cure}I heard it'll still be some time before the Nightkin are cured. Hope they stick around that long.
{Keene dead}The Nightkin aren't going to stick around long with Keene dead. Not without a good reason, anyway.
{Keene left}The Nightkin aren't going to stick around long now that Keene's left. Not without a good reason, anyway.
{Marcus dead}Without Marcus, Jacobstown won't last long.
